name: Lattice by To Go Green™ for WooCommerce
author: togogreen

sections.description:
The Lattice by To Go Green™ for WooCommerce plugin connects your WooCommerce store to Lattice by To Go Green™, making it easy to offer and manage reusable packaging through your Woo Commerce storefronts with no manual tracking or spreadsheets.

Once connected, Lattice by To Go Green™ automatically keeps your store in sync so you can track packaging, manage orders, and give your customers a sustainable packaging option while maximizing ROI.

Support

For support, please contact To Go Green at hello@togogreen.eco.

External services

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Lattice by To Go Green™ service, a reusable packaging tracking platform operated by To Go Green, LLC. The connection is required for the plugin to work.

When you approve the connection, the plugin shares the information needed to sync your store with Lattice by To Go Green™, including your store URL, WooCommerce API credentials, and a secure connection token. After the connection is active, your store sends order and product updates to your Lattice by To Go Green™ account so packaging tracking stays current.

By using this plugin, you agree that To Go Green, LLC may process this data in accordance with its:

  • Terms of Use: https://togogreen.eco/terms-of-use/
  • Privacy Policy: https://togogreen.eco/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce on your WordPress site.
  2. Upload the plugin zip file through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin in WordPress admin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. From the Lattice dashboard, enter your store URL and click Connect.
  5. You will be redirected to WordPress to approve the connection.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

What permissions does the REST API key need?

The plugin creates a read_write key so it can register webhooks and allow Lattice by To Go Green™ to read orders, products, and customers.
